title_as_printed: Summary of experimental conditions and in situ measurement of pH and dissolved CO2.

footnotes_as_printed.b: Calculated from the Pitzer ion-specific-interaction model developed in this study.
footnotes_as_printed.e: Ratio between integrated intensity of the Raman stretching bands (v1 + 2v2) of CO2 and the OH vibration bending band at 1640 cm-1.

pressure_note: Ptot = total pressure in the cell at run temperature; PCO2 column is a CO2 partial pressure (PCO2 = Ptot minus water saturation pressure at run T, checked at 200, 220 and 280 C); cell charged with CO2 partial pressure set between 1 and 50 bar at room temperature then heated; 'vapor saturation pressure' used for the pH buffer calibration only

value.what: CO2 molality measured gravimetrically as BaCO3 (footnote c); empty where nd

value2.what: calculated from Duan and Sun (2003), not measured

value3.what: calculated from the authors' Pitzer model fitted to their data

composition.other_species: H2O-CO2 block: pure water (Milli-Q, CO2-flushed); no salt. NaCl block: 1.4 mol/kg NaCl (stated in text as 1.4 molal)

gas_basis_evidence: molality of CO2 per kg water (mol/kgw); no gas mole fractions
extra_unmapped: Density a (calculated after Duan and Sun 2003, g/cm3 presumably, unit not printed)
pH d (measured potentiometrically at run T, in-situ)
notes: Column headers keep the footnote letters (as separate word, e.g. 'mCO2 a') only to keep the three mCO2 columns and two pH columns distinguishable in the CSV; the letters are footnote markers not part of the names. 'nd' (not determined) written as empty cells (rows without gravimetric mCO2 therefore have empty value; their other columns are still data, e.g. pH d). The authors' primary measured quantities are pH and the Raman ratio; the gravimetric molality is available for 12 of 21 rows. Temperature in C. The NaCl block constant 1.4 m is from the table label 'H2O-CO2-1.4 m NaCl'; the water block NaCl=0 is set by the label 'H2O-CO2'.
